data.define: A polite way to answer thanks.

misuse.text: Don't say 'my pleasure' when you're annoyed.

publish.title: What does "my pleasure" mean?
publish.value: My pleasure = Happy to help. Example: "Thanks! My pleasure." (everyday English).
